set.body:
## Objective and scope

Create the acquisition, provenance and subject-disjoint manifest for fresh qualification. Reserve at least 100 directed pairs from at least 60 unique subjects across three independently sourced cohorts.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Inventory observed development subjects and preprocessing provenance. Existing OASIS/NKI subjects and the 16 used MMRR subjects are observed; the five remaining MMRR subjects cannot by themselves qualify the method.
2. Record source/license, subject identity, scanner/site, resolution, annotations and preprocessing. Check duplicates and overlap with all prior tuning; distinguish independently sourced cohorts from different names sharing one processing/annotation pipeline.
3. Freeze development/qualification assignments and pair construction before model-outcome inspection. Qualification labels are evaluation-only and are not used for selection, masks, fitting, stopping or parameters.
4. Include at least one independent landmark evaluation where available; document any unavailable annotations and permitted substitute before qualification. Reserve a replacement-confirmation strategy for a failed/consumed holdout.

## Planned areas

- docs/datasets.md
- benchmarks/flashalign/manifests/
- dataset acquisition helpers

## Blocking prerequisites

- P01 (`bd-01M4X4DXPNC41BN15X9MBD7HGY`)

## Evidence and safeguards

Use Mote claims/path reservations when implementation begins. Preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical studies. Reuse canonical providers and current owners. Keep labels/evaluation-only masks out of fitting, tuning on qualification data, and runtime stopping. Record exact source/provider/input/config identities, commands, numerical tolerances and all failures; run affected JVM/Scala.js and independent numerical checks. Current geometry/export thresholds cannot be relaxed to improve a pass rate. Completed research may be negative; milestone/epic acceptance remains a separate evidence-based decision.

## References

- docs/benchmarks/real-image-development.md (2026-10-11 accumulated-smoothing and backtracking studies)
- docs/halfflow-capability-ledger.md
- Existing refinement issue bd-01M4NVC83PEY6F4GSGDRD6RFBH and full-boundary issue bd-01M2EG25H20DR7CXNHK22ZF4VE
- Same-affine reference: docs/benchmarks/evidence/real-mri-calibration-20261011/reference-results.json
- SyN method: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2276735/
- Independent evaluation reference: https://github.com/JHU-MedImage-Reg/LUMIR_L2R
